local.text: Whenever a Colorless Pokémon damages 1 of your Pokémon, reduce that damage by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This power stops working if you have more than 1 Unown {N} in play. (This power works even if Unown {N} is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

en.name: [Normal]
en.text: Whenever a Colorless Pokémon damages 1 of your Pokémon, reduce that damage by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This power stops working if you have more than 1 Unown {N} in play. (This power works even if Unown {N} is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

local.name: [Undo]
local.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [U], Unown {N}, Unown {D}, and Unown [O] on your Bench, you may return your Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil and put it onto your Bench or put a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil from your hand onto your Bench.
